points.title: 童年艺术启蒙
points.description: 华特·迪士尼于1901年12月5日出生于芝加哥，是家中第四个孩子。他的父亲伊莱亚斯·迪士尼是爱尔兰裔加拿大人，母亲弗洛拉·考尔是德国裔美国人。童年时期，华特对绘画表现出浓厚兴趣，经常为邻居绘制漫画并赚取零花钱。1917年，他参加芝加哥麦金利高中，同时晚上在芝加哥艺术学院学习绘画课程。这段时期，他开始创作漫画《农场生活》，并在学校报纸上发表。芝加哥的多元文化和艺术氛围为华特早期的艺术发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Walt Disney was born on December 5, 1901, in Chicago, the fourth of five children. His father Elias Disney was of Irish-Canadian descent, and mother Flora Call was of German-American heritage. During his childhood, Walt showed a strong interest in drawing, often creating cartoons for neighbors and earning money. In 1917, he attended McKinley High School while taking night courses at the Chicago Academy of Fine Arts. During this period, he began creating the comic strip 'Farm Life' which was published in the school newspaper. Chicago's diverse culture and artistic atmosphere laid the foundation for Walt's early artistic development.

points.title: 动画事业起步
points.description: 1920年，华特·迪士尼在堪萨斯城开始了他的动画生涯。他在堪萨斯城广告公司担任艺术家，创作广告动画。1922年，他成立了欢笑动画工作室，制作了《小欢乐》系列短片。尽管工作室在1923年因财务困难倒闭，但华特在此积累了宝贵的动画制作经验。他在堪萨斯城创作了《爱丽丝喜剧》系列，将真人表演与动画相结合，这成为他日后创新的雏形。这段挫折经历让华特学会了坚持和适应，为他后来在好莱坞的成功奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1920, Walt Disney began his animation career in Kansas City. He worked as an artist at the Kansas City Film Ad Company, creating animated advertisements. In 1922, he founded Laugh-O-Gram Studio and produced the 'Newman Laugh-O-Grams' series. Although the studio went bankrupt in 1923 due to financial difficulties, Walt gained valuable animation production experience. He created the 'Alice Comedies' series in Kansas City, combining live-action with animation, which became the prototype for his future innovations. This setback taught Walt perseverance and adaptability, laying the foundation for his later success in Hollywood.

points.title: 迪士尼帝国崛起
points.description: 1923年，华特·迪士尼带着仅有的资金和行李前往好莱坞，与哥哥罗伊共同创立了迪士尼兄弟制片厂。1928年，他创造了米老鼠这一标志性角色，并配音了《威利号汽船》，这是第一部有声动画片，大获成功。1932年，迪士尼推出了第一部彩色动画片《花与树》。1937年，他制作了世界上第一部全长动画电影《白雪公主与七个小矮人》，开创了动画电影的新纪元。这一时期，华特还建立了迪士尼乐园的初步构想，并在1940年推出《幻想曲》，将古典音乐与动画完美结合。好莱坞成为迪士尼帝国崛起的核心，华特在这里实现了从动画师到娱乐大亨的转变。
points.descriptionEn: In 1923, Walt Disney moved to Hollywood with only his savings and luggage, and with his brother Roy, founded the Disney Brothers Studio. In 1928, he created the iconic character Mickey Mouse and voiced 'Steamboat Willie,' the first cartoon with synchronized sound, which was a huge success. In 1932, Disney released 'Flowers and Trees,' the first Technicolor cartoon. In 1937, he produced 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs,' the first full-length animated feature film,开创ing a new era for animation. During this period, Walt also began developing the concept of Disneyland and released 'Fantasia' in 1940, perfectly combining classical music with animation. Hollywood became the core of Disney's empire rise, where Walt transformed from an animator to an entertainment tycoon.

points.title: 战争时期贡献
points.description: 第二次世界大战期间，华特·迪士尼的制片厂转为美国政府服务，制作了大量宣传和教育影片。华特亲自参与了《我们向前进》等系列影片的制作，这些影片旨在提升民众士气。迪士尼还制作了《唐老鸭参军》等战争主题动画，以及为军方制作训练影片。尽管战争时期商业动画制作减少，但华特利用这段时间研究了新技术，包括改进的摄影技术和特殊效果。这段经历不仅巩固了迪士尼与美国政府的关系，也为战后迪士尼乐园的构想积累了技术和经验。洛杉矶作为迪士尼的大本营，见证了华特如何将艺术才能服务于国家需求。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Walt Disney's studio shifted to producing propaganda and educational films for the U.S. government. Walt personally participated in creating films like the 'Why We Fight' series, aimed at boosting civilian morale. Disney also produced war-themed cartoons such as 'Donald Duck Drafted' and training films for the military. Although commercial animation production decreased during the war, Walt used this time to research new technologies, including improved cinematography and special effects. This experience not only strengthened Disney's relationship with the U.S. government but also accumulated technical knowledge and experience for the later development of Disneyland. Los Angeles, as Disney's headquarters, witnessed how Walt applied his artistic talents to serve national needs.

points.title: 主题公园梦想成真
points.description: 1955年7月17日，华特·迪士尼的梦想之作——迪士尼乐园在加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆正式对外开放。这座主题公园融合了华特对创新、家庭娱乐和未来科技的热爱，创造了前所未有的沉浸式体验。华特亲自参与了园区的设计和规划，包括主街美国、明日世界、冒险乐园等主题区域。1965年，华特宣布了第二个主题公园——迪士尼世界的计划，这是一个比迪士尼乐园规模更大的项目，包括未来社区实验（EPCOT）的构想。1966年，华特开始规划佛罗里达州的项目，但不幸于同年12月15日因肺癌去世。阿纳海姆的迪士尼乐园成为华特娱乐理念的完美体现，改变了全球娱乐产业的格局。
points.descriptionEn: On July 17, 1955, Walt Disney's dream creation, Disneyland, officially opened in Anaheim, California. This theme park integrated Walt's passion for innovation, family entertainment, and future technology, creating an unprecedented immersive experience. Walt personally participated in the design and planning of the park, including Main Street, U.S.A., Tomorrowland, Adventureland, and other themed areas. In 1965, Walt announced plans for a second theme park, Walt Disney World, a much larger project that included the concept of Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow (EPCOT). In 1966, Walt began planning the Florida project but unfortunately passed away from lung cancer on December 15 of that year. Disneyland in Anaheim became the perfect embodiment of Walt's entertainment philosophy, changing the landscape of the global entertainment industry.

points.title: 遗产与传承
points.description: 1966年12月15日，华特·迪士尼在洛杉矶的圣约瑟夫医院因肺癌去世，享年65岁。他的去世标志着一个时代的结束，但他的遗产却持续影响着全球娱乐产业。华特去世后，他的哥哥罗伊·迪士尼接管了公司，并完成了华特生前规划的迪士尼世界项目。华特的创新精神、对品质的坚持和对家庭娱乐的重视成为迪士尼公司的核心价值观。他的作品和理念影响了几代人，迪士尼乐园和电影成为全球文化现象。华特被追授多项荣誉，包括国会金质奖章和总统自由勋章。他的名字成为创意和梦想的代名词，他的故事激励着无数人追求自己的梦想。
points.descriptionEn: On December 15, 1966, Walt Disney died of lung cancer at St. Joseph's Hospital in Los Angeles at the age of 65. His death marked the end of an era, but his legacy continues to influence the global entertainment industry. After Walt's death, his brother Roy Disney took over the company and completed Walt Disney World, which Walt had planned before his death. Walt's innovative spirit, commitment to quality, and emphasis on family entertainment became the core values of the Disney company. His works and ideas have influenced generations, with Disneyland and his films becoming global cultural phenomena. Walt was posthumously awarded numerous honors, including the Congressional Gold Medal and the Presidential Medal of Freedom. His name has become synonymous with creativity and dreams, and his story continues to inspire countless people to pursue their own dreams.

appraisal.zh: 华特·迪士尼被普遍视为美国梦的化身与创意天才，他把动画提升为独立艺术，创造了米老鼠等经典形象并开创动画长片，迪士尼乐园更重塑了娱乐产业。学界认为他的成功源于商业头脑、艺术才华与对技术革新的前瞻投入。不过也有研究者指出，其早期作品带有种族与性别刻板印象，1941年动画师大罢工暴露了紧张的劳资关系，他的保守政治立场与对创意的严格控制亦受诟病。这些争议并不动摇其文化符号地位，却提醒人们他同样受制于时代。
appraisal.en: Walt Disney is widely seen as an embodiment of the American Dream and a creative genius who elevated animation into an art form, created Mickey Mouse and other iconic characters, pioneered feature animation, and reshaped entertainment with Disneyland. Scholars credit his success to a blend of business acumen, artistic talent, and forward-looking investment in technology. Yet researchers also note the racial and gender stereotypes in his early works, the strained labor relations exposed by the 1941 animators' strike, his conservative politics, and his tight control over creativity. These controversies do not dislodge his status as a cultural symbol, but they remind us that he was also bound by his era.

supporter.zh: 华特·迪士尼被视为美国梦的典范和创意天才的化身。他通过不懈努力和非凡想象力，将动画艺术提升到前所未有的高度，创造了米老鼠、唐老鸭等经典角色，并开创了动画电影这一全新艺术形式。迪士尼乐园的建立彻底改变了娱乐产业的格局，为全球家庭提供了独特的娱乐体验。华特对细节的极致追求、对创新的执着以及将梦想变为现实的能力，使他成为无数人的灵感源泉。他的遗产不仅体现在商业成功上，更在于他对艺术、科技和娱乐融合的远见卓识。
supporter.en: Walt Disney is regarded as a quintessential embodiment of the American Dream and a creative genius. Through relentless effort and extraordinary imagination, he elevated animation art to unprecedented heights, creating iconic characters like Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck, and pioneered the art form of feature animation. The establishment of Disneyland revolutionized the entertainment industry, providing unique experiences for families worldwide. Walt's relentless pursuit of excellence, commitment to innovation, and ability to turn dreams into reality make him an inspiration to countless people. His legacy is not only reflected in commercial success but also in his visionary approach to integrating art, technology, and entertainment.

critic.zh: 批评者指出华特·迪士尼存在明显的局限性：他的作品早期存在种族和性别刻板印象，如《南方之歌》中的种族描绘引发争议；他对劳工权益的态度强硬，1941年动画师大罢工反映了劳资关系的紧张；他的政治立场保守，曾参与麦卡锡主义时期的反共活动；迪士尼乐园的'完美世界'理念被批评为逃避现实，掩盖社会问题。此外，华特对创意的严格控制也限制了艺术家的表达自由。这些争议表明，尽管华特在娱乐领域取得了巨大成功，但他并非完美无缺，其思想和作品也反映了当时社会的局限性。
critic.en: Critics point out Walt Disney's significant limitations: his early works contained racial and gender stereotypes, with racial depictions in 'Song of the South' causing controversy; his tough stance on labor rights led to the 1941 animators' strike, reflecting strained labor relations; his conservative political stance included participation in anti-communist activities during the McCarthy era; Disneyland's 'perfect world' concept has been criticized as escapism that masks social problems. Additionally, Walt's tight control over creativity limited artists' freedom of expression. These controversies indicate that despite his tremendous success in entertainment, Walt was not without flaws, and his thoughts and works reflected the limitations of his time.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，华特·迪士尼已成为美国文化的重要符号，代表着创新、家庭价值观和乐观主义精神。他的作品和主题公园塑造了全球几代人的童年记忆，迪士尼品牌已成为全球最具价值的娱乐品牌之一。学术界认为，华特的成功在于他敏锐的商业头脑与艺术才华的结合，以及他对技术革新的前瞻性投入。迪士尼公司在他去世后继续发展，扩展到媒体网络、流媒体等多个领域，但华特创立的核心价值观——品质、创新和家庭娱乐——仍然影响着公司的发展方向。在流行文化中，华特的形象被不断重塑，从严肃的企业家到富有创造力的梦想家，反映了不同时代对创新精神的诠释。
objective.en: From historical and pop culture perspectives, Walt Disney has become an important symbol of American culture, representing innovation, family values, and optimism. His works and theme parks have shaped the childhood memories of generations worldwide, and the Disney brand has become one of the most valuable entertainment brands globally. Academics believe Walt's success stemmed from his combination of keen business mind and artistic talent, as well as his forward-thinking investment in technological innovation. After his death, Disney Company continued to expand into media networks, streaming, and other fields, but the core values Walt established—quality, innovation, and family entertainment—continue to influence the company's direction. In popular culture, Walt's image has been constantly reshaped, from a serious entrepreneur to a creative dreamer, reflecting different interpretations of the innovative spirit across eras.

self.zh: 如果你能梦想它，你就能实现它。
self.en: If you can dream it, you can do it.
